name: Binary Mutation Guard
summary: Block text-editor mutations against existing binary or binary-signature files.
description: Reads only a bounded prefix without following symlinks, recognizes NUL and common binary signatures, and prevents text Write or Edit tools from corrupting those files.
refuses: It does not block normal binary-producing build commands.
It does not classify UTF-16 text or JSON notebooks as binary solely by extension.
It does not repair, convert, or inspect full binary contents.

entrypoints.purpose: Block text-editor mutations against existing binary or binary-signature files.
